recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any current change to Group.combinationMethod, Group.combinationThreshold invariants, or Group combination value-set semantics should be handled by a current Group/EvidenceVariable tracker, not by replaying the superseded R5 EvidenceVariable request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 CDS issue requesting a more flexible EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination representation, with code, threshold, expanded combination codes, and threshold requirements.
initial_application: Commit bac01125124ef5d906e86c9f6d75340772380ce2 applied the issue by changing EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination to a code/threshold backbone and updating the characteristic-combination CodeSystem from intersection/union to all-of, any-of, at-least, at-most, and net-effect.
additional_context: FHIR-36131 later removed EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination for R5 eligibility-criteria support. FHIR-41583 added Group.combinationMethod and Group.combinationThreshold. FHIR-42886 then removed EvidenceVariable.characteristic entirely and made EvidenceVariable.definition a CodeableReference to Group.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active EvidenceVariable source no longer contains characteristicCombination or definitionByCombination, and the current active combination elements are Group.combinationMethod and Group.combinationThreshold.

related_jiras.note: Removed EvidenceVariable.characteristicCombination before R5 publication and replaced it with EvidenceVariable.characteristic.definitionByCombination.
